Saint Seiya - Ougon Densetsu Hen - Perfe.summary:
Saint Seiya: Ougon Densetsu-hen - Perfect Edition is a Role-Playing game, developed by TOSE and published by Bandai, which was released in Japan in 2003.

It is a remake of the two NES games in the Saint Seiya: Ougon Densetsu series. It is an adaptation of the anime more faithful and complete than its original versions, although various functions and combats were also excluded from it.
